# EspaLuz

> EspaLuz helps families who moved to a Spanish-speaking country live real life in Spanish: the doctor, public offices and the school gate, the local words and customs of 21 countries, and a kids classroom where Pere the sloth and Titi the monkey keep children learning. Web, WhatsApp and Telegram. 14 days free, then $11 a month.

## Main pages
- [EspaLuz overview](https://aideazz.xyz/espaluz): who it is for, what it does, prices, questions families ask
- [EspaLuz app](https://app.espaluz.lat/): sign in, the kids classroom, chat
- [WhatsApp](https://wa.me/50766623757) and [Telegram](https://t.me/EspaLuzFamily_bot): the same EspaLuz in chat
